+Order(orderId: int, customer: Customer, item: MenuItem, priceCents: int, turnPlaced: int)
: + public, - private, # protected; «boundary» collects and displays,
«control» coordinates, «entity» holds game state. Filled diamond =
composition, hollow diamond = aggregation, dashed arrow = dependency.
markServed, markPaid and cancel; illegal calls throw IllegalActionException.
(filled diamond): Restaurant owns its 2 Tables, waiting
queue, menu, stats and config; TurnEngine owns the three staff roles.
billCents() are overridable. Stage 2 adds VIPCustomer and CriticCustomer; the
turn controller does not change. Stage 1 has no inheritance yet.
: ConsoleUI only reads state and collects
choices; legality is decided in Restaurant, Waiter, Chef and Cashier.
